title: 【見本】ラーメン屋POVロールプレイ（開発用フィクスチャ）

sentences.en: Welcome back to the ramen shop, everyone!
sentences.ja: みんな、ラーメン屋におかえり！

sentences.en: Today I'm gonna be your ramen chef.
sentences.ja: 今日は私がラーメンシェフです。

sentences.en: Okay, what would you like to order?
Wait, you want extra garlic? Bold choice.
sentences.ja: にんにく増し？攻めるねえ。

sentences.en: Let me take my jacket off, it's getting hot in here.
sentences.ja: 上着脱ぐね、暑くなってきた。

sentences.en: I was so excited to open this shop.
sentences.ja: このお店を開くのすごく楽しみだったの。

sentences.en: Here's your bowl. Careful, it's really hot.
sentences.ja: はいどうぞ。熱いから気をつけて。

sentences.en: Do you want some more noodles?
No refills? That's fine, that's fine.
sentences.ja: おかわりなし？大丈夫、大丈夫。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming today!
sentences.ja: 今日は来てくれて本当にありがとう！

sentences.en: Oh, chat says the broth looks amazing.
sentences.ja: スープがおいしそうってチャットが言ってる。

sentences.en: I actually made it from scratch.
sentences.ja: 実はイチから作ったんだ。

sentences.en: It took me like six hours.
Don't tell anyone the secret recipe.
sentences.ja: 秘伝のレシピは誰にも言わないでね。

sentences.en: Okay, next customer, please!
sentences.ja: はい、次のお客さんどうぞ！

sentences.en: You look kind of familiar.
Have we met before?
Anyway, what can I get you?
One miso ramen, coming right up!
See you next time, bye bye!
